# Pkl 0.32.0 collection addition Java authority

This fixture records 125 ordered public `evaluateExpressionString` calls against the pinned Pkl 0.32.0 Java evaluator. The canonical module URI is `file:///stage63/collection-addition.pkl`. Two fresh JVM sessions produced 86 successful values and 39 ordinary Pkl errors each. Every query retains the producer's UTF-8 and UTF-16BE strings, status, exception and cause metadata, and complete process stdout and stderr. The independent offline verifier checks the entire archive, ordered protocol, copied inputs and 45 pinned sources, actual JAR and JDK identities, and byte equality between sessions.

The rows cover List and Set cross-kind `+`, Map `+`, order and duplicates, empty operands and chains, equal but differently rendered Duration keys, nested object keys, numeric box distinctions, hash collisions and the sixteenth-to-seventeenth element boundary. Module-bound prebuilt Set and Map operands exercise equal object keys at the merge. Other rows cover lazy nested values, operand evaluation order, and invalid operator diagnostics, including a right-hand integer literal. A Set with a throwing object element fails during Set construction and hashing before `+`; it is an operand-order control, not proof of concatenation retry behavior.

The pinned Java `VmList`, `VmSet`, and `VmMap` sources return the left `Vm` object when the right collection is empty. Public string calls do not observe that internal reference identity. This fixture makes no Java wrapper identity, typed export, native, Node, browser, full M2, or performance pass claim. The earlier 86- and 111-row target-only explorations and the three earlier canonical attempts remain separate historical evidence; `capture-04` is the sole canonical raw archive here. Expected bytes came only from Java.
